notes: Lakeland (lakeland.co.uk), UK kitchenware/homeware specialist on Shopify. Direct HTTP fetch worked throughout (HTTP 200, no WAF), consistent with the prior Home-Decor pass on this same site. Method: enumerated the full collections.json catalog (602 collections across 3 pages of 250) and keyword-scanned all titles/handles for pet-related terms (pet, dog, cat, puppy, kitten, kennel, litter, collar, leash, lead, hamster, rabbit, bird cage, aquarium, fish tank, hutch, scratch, chew, harness, crate, carrier, bowl, feeder, groom, paw, hound, canine, feline, claw, fur, bark) to avoid missing anything not obviously named 'pet'. Also checked the rendered homepage HTML for a 'Pets' mega-nav entry -- none found, confirming the site has no dedicated Pet section (consistent with its narrow kitchenware-specialist positioning noted in the prior category pass). Only two collections carry genuine pet products: 'Pet Care & Cleaning' (handle pet-care-cleaning, 14 raw products) and 'Pet Food & Treats' (handle pet-food-and-treats, 7 raw products). Both are flat single-level collections with no distinct child PLPs -- verified every product in each via the collection's own products.json title/type/body_html dump and manually filtered per 'drop, don't pad'. 'Pet Care & Cleaning' (14 raw -> 10 in-scope): dropped Lakeland Pet Hair Removers (Laundry Accessories -- a home lint/hair-removal tool used ON furniture/clothing, not on the pet), Quick Shine Plant-Based Pet-Friendly Floor Cleaner (a general floor cleaner merely marketed as pet-safe, not a pet product), UltraGrime Pet Cleanup XXL+ Clothwipes (general household cleaning wipes), and Dog and Bond Star Barker Wooden Spoon (a kitchen baking spoon, pet-themed novelty not a pet-use item -- belongs with Kitchen & Dining, not Pet Care). Kept the 10 genuine pet items: 4 dog/cat/pet bowls (feeding), 4 grooming items (brush, grooming mitt, washing brush, towel), 2 pet food/treat storage items (tin+scoop, treat jar). 'Pet Food & Treats' (7 raw -> 6 in-scope): dropped 'Lakeland 12.5m Sausage Skins - For Up To 60 Sausages' -- its own product description confirms it is for making human sausages ('perfect if you're throwing a huge barbecue... Sunday morning bangers'), evidently misfiled into this collection; no pet reference in the listing at all. The remaining 6 are genuine Dog and Bond dog treat/ice-cream/cake mixes -- flagged per the open pet-consumable policy gap rather than silently included or dropped. No cat-repellent, bird-feeder, or other pest-control/wildlife item qualifies (Cat Repellent is a garden pest deterrent aimed at keeping cats OUT, not a pet product; Bird Feeder is an outdoor wild-bird house, not pet care). No Pet Beds, Pet Toys, Pet Clothing, Litter, Crates, Carriers, Leashes/Collars, or Training categories exist anywhere on the site -- absence confirmed via the full 602-collection title/handle scan plus the homepage nav check, not a site-search false-absence result.
